paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Japan

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the distribution of counts across different polarity scores. The x-axis is labeled "Polarity scores," features a linear scale, and ranges from -1.0 to 0.6 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "Counts" also uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 40000, with tick labels at intervals of 10000. A single line on the plot is colored blue with circular markers, connected by a solid line style. Starting at the x-axis value of -1.0, where the count is approximately 0, the line remains relatively flat until around -0.3, where it starts to rise, reaching a peak count of around 40000 at a polarity score of 0.0. The line then drops sharply to near 0.1, before rising again to a smaller peak around 20000 at a polarity score of 0.2. Following this, the line descends with several fluctuations, reaching smaller peaks around x-axis values of 0.3 and 0.4 before ending at approximately 0 at the x-axis value of 0.6.
